Come with me as I tour prep in LA including dance rehearsal, shopping, eating & bowling!
Hey guys! I know it's been a while, but I've been prepping for a new tour and writing and recording so many new songs. If you're in the US, come see me on tour! I'm playing a full original music set and I'm so so excited to share it with you!
Special thanks to Discover LA for the support of this video!
Directed & Edited by Taylor Miller
